name: shipping
title: Shipping
summary: How things get delivered: carriers and services, destinations and excluded areas, shipping profiles with rates (Official Store and sellers), free-shipping rules, dispatch targets and cutoffs, the holiday and service-interruption calendar, delivery estimates for a location, shipments with contents and tracking, labels where supported, partial shipments, and delivery exceptions with their required responses and carrier claims.
owns: Carriers, carrier services, tracking connections and on-time rates
Platform shipping methods (Standard, Expedited, Express, Large items) and the carrier services behind them
Destinations: served zones with transit times and excluded areas (PO boxes, military, Alaska, Hawaii, territories)
Shipping profiles with rates per method (flat, by weight, by order value), free-shipping thresholds and effective dates, for the Official Store and each seller
Standing free-shipping thresholds of the Official Store and sellers (company- or seller-funded); platform-funded free shipping in campaigns and coupons belongs to promotions
Dispatch targets and cutoffs: Official Store cutoff, default seller targets, seller handling time, business days and closures
Holiday and service-interruption calendar shown on product pages, checkout and tracking
Delivery estimates and shipping quotes for a location (used by offers, cart and checkout) and dispatch deadlines
Shipments: package contents, carrier, service, tracking number with format checks, ship date, corrections with history, partial shipments, replacement and return parcels
Label purchase where the carrier is supported (sellers in Seller Center, warehouse for the Official Store, returns for return labels)
Tracking events from carrier webhooks and polling, normalized to one status model
Delivery exceptions with required responses: seller cannot fulfill, late dispatch, missing tracking, lost or damaged, failed delivery (with the customer's next-step choice)
notOwns: Fulfillment tasks, item states and cancellations: orders (shipping reports shipments; orders moves the items)
Picking and packing Official Store packages: warehouse (buys labels and hands packages over through shipping)
Seller return address and return terms: returns

Shipping discounts in campaigns and coupons, including platform-funded free shipping: promotions (evaluateCart applies them per package; shipping only keeps standing Official Store and seller thresholds)
Generic work queue items, owners and escalation timers: workqueues (fed by shipping events)
Seller performance scoring: sellers (reads shipping events and dispatchMetrics)

publicApi.name: quote
publicApi.signature: (profileId: uuid, postalCode: string, parcel: Parcel, dispatch: DispatchInput, orderValue?: Money) => DeliveryQuote
publicApi.desc: Delivery options for one offer at a location: ships-to check, price per method, arrival range, dispatch label, cutoff countdown and service notices. orderValue (item price × quantity) is checked against free-shipping thresholds and order-value rates (the option then carries free and freeReason); without it no threshold is reached. freeOver: the default method's threshold

publicApi.name: quoteOptions
publicApi.signature: (input: PackageQuoteInput) => PackageQuote
publicApi.desc: Options for a package of several items from one seller and ship-from location: methods common to every item's profile, combined weight, free-shipping threshold on the package subtotal, arrival per option

publicApi.name: checkCoverage
publicApi.signature: (profileIds: uuid[], destination: Address) => CoverageCheck[]

publicApi.name: hasCoverage
publicApi.signature: (sellerId: uuid) => bool

publicApi.name: dispatchDeadline
publicApi.signature: (ownerType: 'official'|'seller', sellerId: uuid | null, from: datetime, dispatch: DispatchInput) => datetime
publicApi.desc: Dispatch deadline from acceptance time, handling days, same-day cutoff, business days and closures. No module calls it at launch: checkout takes each option's dispatchBy from quoteOptions.

publicApi.name: activeNotices
publicApi.signature: (postalCode?: string, carrierCodes?: string[], surface?: string) => CustomerNotice[]

publicApi.name: estimateLabelCost
publicApi.signature: (input: LabelRequest) => Money | null
publicApi.desc: What createLabel would charge for this request (the given carrier service, else the one createLabel would pick), without buying a label or keeping a quote; null when no carrier can sell it. Returns shows sellers the return label price before they approve (G55c).

publicApi.name: quoteLabelOptions
publicApi.signature: (input: LabelRequest) => LabelQuote[]
publicApi.desc: Carrier services that can carry this parcel to the destination, with cost, estimated arrival and keepsPromise against the customer's promised range (same rule createLabel enforces with keepPromise)

publicApi.name: createLabel
publicApi.signature: (input: LabelRequest, idempotencyKey: string) => LabelResult
publicApi.desc: Buy a carrier label and create the shipment (label_created). kind = return creates the return parcel for returns (labelMethod prepaid_qr adds a QR drop-off code; LabelRequest.dropOffBy from the return is stored and returned on the label); format pdf (default) or zpl; its tracking events carry kind = return and returnId. Same key returns the same label. fulfillment-service (phase 4) will call it when its label flow is wired.

publicApi.name: voidLabel
publicApi.signature: (labelId: uuid, reason: string) => Label

publicApi.name: handOver
publicApi.signature: (shipmentId: uuid, at: datetime, actor: Actor) => Shipment
publicApi.desc: Package handed to the carrier (label_created → shipped). Publishes shipping.shipment.dispatched. No module calls it at launch (warehouse records hand-over on its own parcels); kept for fulfillment-service (phase 4).

publicApi.desc: On-time dispatch, valid tracking and late counts. reviews shows the seller dispatch facts on seller ratings; sellers and reports compute their own figures. A seller's figures leave out Fulfilled by Marketly shipments (fulfilled_by marketly_service): Marketly dispatched them.

publicApi.name: registerReturnTracking
publicApi.signature: (input: { returnId: uuid, orderId: uuid, groupId: uuid, carrierCode: string, trackingNumber: string, to: Address }) => Shipment

publicApi.signature: (offerIds: uuid[], postalCode?: string, viewer?: { customerId?: uuid, guestSessionId?: uuid }) => OfferEstimate[]

publicApi.name: openExceptionIdsForOrders

publicApi.name: listExceptionsForOrder

publicApi.name: listExceptions
publicApi.signature: (filter: { kind?: string, status?: string, sellerType?: string, ownerStaffId?: uuid, customerNotNotified?: bool, q?: string }, page: PageInput) => Page<DeliveryException>

publicApi.name: countOpenExceptions

stateMachines.name: Shipment
stateMachines.notes: A shipment recorded by a seller with tracking is created as label_created and handed over in the same transaction (publishes shipping.shipment.dispatched). Until the first carrier scan the customer sees 'Shipped, tracking pending'. deliver only from a carrier event (or a staff record with evidence for carriers without tracking); never from the seller. Corrections to tracking keep the status and add a correction record. Return parcels (kind=return) use the same model.

stateMachines.name: Delivery exception
stateMachines.notes: Required responses (plan ch. 12): seller_cannot_fulfill: flag items, notify the customer, apply cancellation and refund policy (closes when the refund is sent). late_dispatch: overdue task, notify the seller, offer the customer support escalation (closes on dispatch or cancellation). missing_tracking: request valid details, never imply delivery (closes on a valid scan). lost_or_damaged: case with item, carrier details and agreed remedy (may file a carrier claim). failed_delivery: show redelivery, pickup or return steps and costs (closes on delivery or return to sender). condition_cleared is automatic; resolve records the resolution and who did it. Escalate to the Seller Manager when a seller misses a second deadline.

stateMachines.name: Carrier claim
stateMachines.notes: Claims above claimFinanceApprovalAbove need Finance approval (access approval request) before submit. paid records paidAmount; finance books it (shipping.claim.status_changed). The customer remedy does not wait for the claim.

stateMachines.name: Service notice
stateMachines.notes: go_live at showFrom (or the from date), end after the to date (job). Live notices adjust estimates (extra transit days, no pickup or dispatch days) and are shown on the chosen surfaces.

stateMachines.name: Shipping profile version
stateMachines.notes: Saving creates a new version; the previous active version is superseded when the new one takes effect. Quotes use the version active at quote time and checkout freezes the result on the order. Archive is refused while active offers use the profile (PROFILE_IN_USE).

stateMachines.name: Label
stateMachines.notes: Voiding is possible only before the first carrier scan; the carrier refunds the cost and finance reverses the charge (shipping.label.voided).

consumes.name: orders.dispatch_deadline.changed
consumes.does: Move the watched deadline (the original stays on record for performance)

consumes.name: orders.item.cancelled
consumes.does: Remove items from the watch; open (or update) a seller_cannot_fulfill exception when the seller cancelled; close dispatch exceptions when nothing is left to ship; void unused labels

consumes.name: warehouse.package.packed
consumes.does: Warehouse package (Official Store or Fulfilled by Marketly) handed to the carrier pickup (handOver); the shipment is recorded with the payload's owner (ownerType, sellerId) and fulfilledBy, never a hard-coded official owner

consumes.name: sellers.seller.restricted
consumes.does: Mark open exceptions of the seller for escalation to the Seller Manager

consumes.name: support.case.opened
consumes.does: Open a lost_or_damaged exception for missing or damaged package reports when none is open for that group and package (source customer_report, caseRef set, shipmentId from the report when given)

consumes.name: returns.replacement.created
consumes.does: Watch the replacement's dispatch like an original shipment (with or without a return: returnId may be null for a replacement decided on a case)

consumes.name: payments.refund.sent
consumes.does: Close seller_cannot_fulfill exceptions whose refund was sent

Create, publish and withdraw holiday and service notices
Correct tracking and record missed carrier events (reason required)
Open, assign, notify, escalate and resolve exceptions
Open and update carrier claims (Finance approval above the limit)
See the seller's shipping settings and profiles
Change coverage, rates, dispatch schedule and closures
See shipments, exceptions and claims on the seller's orders
Record shipments, buy and void labels, correct tracking, respond to exceptions

approvalActions.approvers: Shipping Manager up to claimFinanceApprovalAbove (e.g. $1,000); Finance Manager above it

jobs.name: shipping.detect-late-dispatch
jobs.does: Groups past their dispatch deadline with unshipped items: open a late_dispatch exception, notify the seller and publish shipping.dispatch.overdue (once per group per deadline)

jobs.name: shipping.detect-missing-tracking
jobs.does: Shipments without tracking, with an invalid number, or a label without a carrier scan after labelScanGraceHours: open missing_tracking

jobs.name: shipping.detect-stalled
jobs.does: Shipments with no carrier scan for stalledNoScanDays: open lost_or_damaged for review

jobs.name: shipping.poll-tracking
jobs.does: Poll carriers in polling mode and unknown webhook numbers

jobs.name: shipping.failed-delivery-default
jobs.does: Failed deliveries past chooseBy without a choice follow the default (return to seller) and notify customer and seller

jobs.name: shipping.activate-versions
jobs.does: Activate scheduled profile and settings versions; supersede the previous ones

jobs.name: shipping.notice-schedule
jobs.does: Move notices scheduled → live at showFrom and live → ended after the to date

jobs.name: shipping.carrier-on-time
jobs.does: Compute 30-day on-time rates per carrier and the Official Store dispatch rate

ITEMS_NOT_SHIPPABLE.meaning: Items are not in this group, cancelled, already shipped, or the quantity is more than remains. details.items.

TRACKING_FORMAT_INVALID.meaning: The tracking number does not match the carrier's format. Resend with acknowledgeFormatWarning=true to save it anyway (a missing_tracking check stays open until a carrier scan).

TRACKING_ALREADY_USED.meaning: This tracking number is on another active shipment.

LABELS_NOT_SUPPORTED.meaning: No label-capable service for this package; enter tracking manually.

LABEL_FAILED.meaning: The carrier did not sell the label; nothing was charged. 422 when the carrier refused (change the package or service), 502 when the carrier could not be reached (try again; decision G42). details.carrierMessage, details.carrierReached (bool).

QUOTE_EXPIRED.meaning: The label quote expired; get a new quote.

HANDLING_OUT_OF_RANGE.meaning: Handling days are outside the platform's allowed range. details.min, details.max.

PROFILE_IN_USE.meaning: Active offers use this profile. details.offerCount.

CHOICE_WINDOW_CLOSED.meaning: The time to choose a next step has passed; the default was applied.

EXCEPTION_ALREADY_OPEN.meaning: An open exception of this kind exists for the group and package (or for the group when no package is named). details.exceptionId.

WEBHOOK_SIGNATURE_INVALID.meaning: The carrier signature did not verify.

FULFILLED_BY_MARKETLY.meaning: Marketly ships this package; you can't record shipments, buy labels, correct tracking or answer exceptions for it.

notes: Estimates: arrival = dispatch date (acceptance + handling business days, same-day cutoff, business days, seller closures, notices with noDispatch) + carrier transit for the destination zone (zone transit by method, extra days from live notices, carrier no-pickup/no-delivery days). Shown as a DateRange; cutoffAt drives 'Order within …'.

Package quotes (cart and checkout): methods available on every item's profile; price per method = rate for the combined weight (by_weight), the highest per-package flat rate among items (flat_per_package) or the order-value tier of the package subtotal (by_order_value); free when the package subtotal reaches the profile threshold or a free-shipping rule applies (fundedBy recorded on the option and frozen on the order).

Dispatch deadlines: checkout gets dispatchBy per option and orders freezes it. The dispatch watch is fed by orders.order.accepted; overdue detection opens one late_dispatch exception per group and deadline, notifies the seller, and orders turns the items Delayed (customer told, with support route). workqueues mirrors these as queue items with lead, backup and escalation.
Missing tracking never implies delivery: until a carrier scan, customers see 'Shipped, tracking pending', and deliver only comes from a carrier event (or a staff-recorded event with proof).
Partial shipments: a shipment covers chosen items and quantities; orders splits lines; remaining items keep their deadline. Corrections keep history and notify the buyer.

Labels: sellers (Seller Center, cost deducted from earnings via shipping.label.purchased → finance), warehouse (Official Store, company cost) and returns (return labels, billed per return responsibility; billedTo customer when the customer pays and returns deducts it from the refund) all buy through createLabel with an idempotency key; nobody calls carriers directly. The label keeps the requested format (pdf or zpl), its carrier service and, for return labels, the drop-off deadline returns passed in LabelRequest.dropOffBy.

Seller endpoints act on the caller's seller only: shipments and exceptions of other sellers return NOT_FOUND. Return address and return terms live in returns; the seller/shipping screen shows them from there.

Service notices are scoped by carrier or single carrier services, by states, ZIP prefixes or zones, and by seller scope (all, Official Store only, marketplace sellers only). activeNotices matches a location by postal prefix and state; POST /notices/preview shows the checkout message and the moved arrival estimates before publishing. Notices change arrival estimates, never dispatch deadlines, unless noDispatch is set.

Carrier contacts (plan ch. 2: the Shipping Manager maintains carrier contacts) are stored on the carrier (account manager, operations, claims, billing, escalation) and edited with POST/PATCH /carriers; they are never returned to sellers.
Official Store: ownerType official with sellerId null (as in offers). Its profile and dispatch schedule are edited in the admin area.

Carriers and carrier services (decision D-S1) are defined by the carrier adapters and seeded by a shipping migration (codes, services, transit, label support, tracking patterns). Seeded carriers (decision G40a): UPS, USPS, FedEx, OnTrac and Other carrier (tracking optional: a shipment without a number is recorded with tracking missing); existing installs get the missing ones at the next start; there are no create endpoints for services or methods. POST /carriers only records the account of a carrier an adapter supports; staff then enable services and set transit with PATCH.

Seller handling range (decision D-S2): the sellerHandlingRange setting is the only source of the allowed handling days; dispatch targets show it read-only and updateSellerSettings checks against it (HANDLING_OUT_OF_RANGE).

Ships from: each seller's ships-from text is stored in its shipping settings (seller_settings.ships_from, set in PUT /settings), so storefront summaries and dispatch labels for many sellers are read in one query; shipping never calls sellers for it (sellers calls shipping, so a call back would be circular).

Delivery exceptions are unique per (group, kind, package) while open (decision D-S3): a second lost or late package of the same group gets its own exception; exceptions without a package stay one per group and kind.

Profile checks: archiving refuses while offers use the profile; the count comes from offers.countActiveOffersByProfile (exact count, no paging cap). offers checks profile ownership with getProfileOwners.

Direct customer notices (notifyCustomer, tracking corrections, failed-delivery default, exception updates) are addressed with Recipient.customerId when the order has a customer (customers-module id from the order), and to the order contact email only for guests; customer ids are never used as identity account ids.

Dependencies: architecture lists orders. Optional: offers (resolve offer → profile and dispatch for GET /estimates; countActiveOffersByProfile for PROFILE_IN_USE), notifications (direct customer notices), sellers (names, restriction state), media (claim evidence, label files), support (link lost/damaged cases), access (claim approvals), settings (market time zone and default location).

Fulfilled by Marketly (fulfillment-service, phase 4): groups with fulfilledBy marketly_service are a seller's packages that Marketly's warehouse ships. Quotes (quoteOptions with fulfilledBy marketly_service) use Official dispatch settings, closures and cutoffs and the Official profile-owner check, from the service location (fulfillment-service.getServiceLocation). The dispatch watch, shipments and exceptions keep fulfilled_by; the deadline follows the Official schedule. warehouse.package.packed records the shipment with the seller as owner (ownerType seller, sellerId) and the warehouse's label is billed to the seller (decision D1; finance books it like other seller labels). shipment.created, shipment.dispatched, dispatch.overdue and shipment.exception carry fulfilledBy. Exceptions on those groups are owned by the Shipping Manager with no seller notice and no seller response; dispatchMetrics for a seller leaves them out. Seller endpoints (recordShipment, quoteLabels, buyLabel, markLabelHandedOver, correctTrackingSeller, respondToException) answer 409 FULFILLED_BY_MARKETLY for them; label quotes for such a group start from the service location.
